title.zh: 伊芙琳 · 牵缠与连携循环

summary.zh: 伊芙琳站场攒点，莱特喷发打失衡，嘉音按真实支援与能量补增益。
summary.en: Evelyn builds points on field, Lighter bursts Daze, and Astra buffs through actual assists and energy.

conditions.zh: 站位循环为嘉音→伊芙琳→莱特，让嘉音下一位是伊芙琳；替换连携仍以实际提示为准，普通切入不冒充加攻触发。
conditions.en: Use Astra → Evelyn → Lighter cyclically, with Evelyn next after Astra. Converted Chains still require the actual prompt; ordinary entries are not ATK triggers.

conditions.zh: 开唱与加攻分开：加攻还要25能量和对应支援/连携入场；已有增益按真实剩余状态判断。
conditions.en: Singing and ATK are separate: ATK also needs 25 energy and a qualifying assist/Chain entry; check actual existing buffs.

conditions.zh: 只在牵缠仍在的退场时标自动束裂；不保证固定次数连携或最高分。
conditions.en: Automatic Binding Sunder is marked only on a still-bound exit; no fixed Chain count or maximum score is guaranteed.

label.zh: 陈十四 · 伊芙琳操作（1.5）
陈十四 · 耀嘉音支援条件（1.5）

objective.zh: 先开唱、牵缠并积攒真实资源。
objective.en: Start singing, bind the target and build real resources.

input.zh: 点按特殊技；需要聚怪时按实际场景蓄力。
input.en: Press Special; charge when grouping is useful.

trigger.zh: 咏叹华彩尚未开启或已退出。
trigger.en: Idyllic Cadenza is inactive or has ended.

complete.zh: 确认唱歌状态；要获得加攻，还需有25能量并让输出通过合法支援/连携入场。
complete.en: Verify the singing state. ATK additionally needs 25 energy and a qualifying assist/Chain entry by the recipient.

reason.zh: 开唱提供持续状态；并不等于全队已无条件吃到攻击力。
reason.en: Singing provides a persistent state, not unconditional ATK for everyone.

fallback.zh: 没有能量先按实际状态普通切人准备，不把普通切换记成加攻触发。
fallback.en: Without energy, use ordinary switches for setup without crediting the ATK trigger.

signal.zh: 完成开唱后切伊芙琳准备；普通切入不自动记加攻。
signal.en: After singing starts, switch to Evelyn for setup; an ordinary entry does not automatically grant ATK.

input.zh: 未牵缠时点按特殊技，确认踢击命中。
input.en: While unbound, press Special and land the kick.

trigger.zh: 主要目标还没有牵缠禁制。
trigger.en: The main target is not yet under Binding Seal.

complete.zh: 确认与目标的牵绳；已有牵缠时跳过这一步。
complete.en: Verify the tether; skip this step if already bound.

reason.zh: 未牵缠与已牵缠的特殊技分支不同，不能机械连续按E当作同一招。
reason.en: Bound and unbound Special branches differ; repeated E is not always the same move.

fallback.zh: 未命中重新定位；已有牵缠时使用对应束裂或普攻路线。
fallback.en: After a miss, reposition. When already bound, use the appropriate Binding Sunder or Basic route.

title.en: Build Burning Embers through on-field hits

input.zh: 普攻积蓄，按实际攻击机会闪避反击；第五段命中可重新牵缠。
input.en: Use Basics and real Dodge-Counter opportunities; Basic 5 can restore the tether on hit.

trigger.zh: 燎火或燎索点需要积累，目标可命中。
trigger.en: Burning Embers or Burning Tether Points need building and the target is hittable.

complete.zh: 看真实燎火达到50%后转绞勒；准备失衡前避免资源空缺。
complete.en: At an actual 50% Embers, use Garrote; prepare resources before Stun.

reason.zh: 伤害命中才积燎火；不把固定一套普攻当作满条。
reason.en: Damage hits build Embers; one fixed Basic string is not assumed to fill the gauge.

fallback.zh: 敌人移动先追位；已有3点可按窗口主动连携，别继续无效攒点。
fallback.en: Reposition against movement; at three points, use a suitable Chain window rather than overbuilding.

label.zh: 咏叹华彩 · 仅仍在唱歌时

title.en: Convert 50% Embers into a Tether Point

input.zh: 燎火≥50%时长按普攻；还够50%可继续长按接II型。
input.en: Hold Basic with at least 50% Embers; another 50% allows continued hold into Type II.

trigger.zh: 燎火足够；已有3点时此输入会转主动连携，应按对应窗口处理。
trigger.en: Enough Embers; at three points the input becomes a personal Chain and should use that branch.

complete.zh: 每实际发动一型增加1点；查看当前点数，不把I型一次当作两点。
complete.en: Each actual Garrote adds one point; Type I alone is not two points.

reason.zh: 首次终结技后仍需3点启动主动连携，只是发动后保留1点。
reason.en: After the first Ultimate, personal Chain still starts at three points; it merely retains one afterward.

fallback.zh: 不足50%回积蓄；2影返还存在冷却，不每次假定免费。
fallback.en: Below 50%, build more. M2 refunds have a cooldown and are not always free.

objective.zh: 伊芙琳攒点，莱特士气到位再接管。
objective.en: Build Evelyn’s points and hand over when Lighter’s Morale is ready.

title.en: Build Burning Embers through on-field hits

input.zh: 普攻积蓄，按实际攻击机会闪避反击；第五段命中可重新牵缠。
input.en: Use Basics and real Dodge-Counter opportunities; Basic 5 can restore the tether on hit.

trigger.zh: 燎火或燎索点需要积累，目标可命中。
trigger.en: Burning Embers or Burning Tether Points need building and the target is hittable.

complete.zh: 看真实燎火达到50%后转绞勒；准备失衡前避免资源空缺。
complete.en: At an actual 50% Embers, use Garrote; prepare resources before Stun.

reason.zh: 伤害命中才积燎火；不把固定一套普攻当作满条。
reason.en: Damage hits build Embers; one fixed Basic string is not assumed to fill the gauge.

fallback.zh: 敌人移动先追位；已有3点可按窗口主动连携，别继续无效攒点。
fallback.en: Reposition against movement; at three points, use a suitable Chain window rather than overbuilding.

label.zh: 咏叹华彩 · 仅仍在唱歌时

input.zh: 燎火≥50%时长按普攻；还够50%可继续长按接II型。
input.en: Hold Basic with at least 50% Embers; another 50% allows continued hold into Type II.

trigger.zh: 燎火足够；已有3点时此输入会转主动连携，应按对应窗口处理。
trigger.en: Enough Embers; at three points the input becomes a personal Chain and should use that branch.

complete.zh: 每实际发动一型增加1点；查看当前点数，不把I型一次当作两点。
complete.en: Each actual Garrote adds one point; Type I alone is not two points.

reason.zh: 首次终结技后仍需3点启动主动连携，只是发动后保留1点。
reason.en: After the first Ultimate, personal Chain still starts at three points; it merely retains one afterward.

fallback.zh: 不足50%回积蓄；2影返还存在冷却，不每次假定免费。
fallback.en: Below 50%, build more. M2 refunds have a cooldown and are not always free.

title.zh: 终结技就绪，开启整场焰舞觉醒
title.en: Use a ready Ultimate to activate Dance of Awakened Fire

input.zh: 首次终结技已就绪时发动；已觉醒时对应后续终结技分支。
input.en: Use the first Ultimate when ready; after awakening use its later Ultimate variant.

trigger.zh: 伊芙琳自己的终结技就绪，目标可命中且当前输出时机合适。
trigger.en: Evelyn’s own Ultimate is ready, the target is hittable and the damage opportunity is suitable.

complete.zh: 首次发动进入整场觉醒；发动后增加1燎索点，按真实点数决定后续。
complete.en: The first use activates battle-long awakening; it adds one Tether Point, so read the actual total afterward.

reason.zh: 不是开场自带，也不是只要2点就能启动连携；必须先实际开过终结技。
reason.en: It is not present at the start and does not reduce the Chain-start threshold to two; the Ultimate must actually have been used.

fallback.zh: 未就绪跳过，不为等大招空站；已觉醒仍要等自己的终结技再次可用。
fallback.en: Skip if unavailable rather than waiting idle; after awakening the next Ultimate still needs to be ready.

title.en: At 80 Morale, enter with Lighter’s Quick Assist

input.zh: 士气达到80后换入莱特；确认实际快速支援，再长按普攻。
input.en: At 80 Morale, bring Lighter in; confirm the real Quick Assist, then hold Basic.

trigger.zh: 真实士气≥80；莱特此时换入前台能触发自身快支。
trigger.en: Actual Morale is at least 80 and his next entry triggers his own Quick Assist.

complete.zh: 快支动作完成，直接衔接第五段；尚未命中不能计入增益。
complete.en: Finish the assist and connect Basic 5; no buff is credited before hits.

reason.zh: 此入口来自莱特自身士气机制，不把普通切入假称快支。
reason.en: This entry comes from Lighter’s own Morale mechanic; an ordinary switch is not mislabeled Quick Assist.

fallback.zh: 未满80先继续队友准备；若普通切入则按实际招式接第五段，不假定已进入喷发。
fallback.en: Below 80, continue teammate setup. After an ordinary entry, use a legal Basic-5 route without assuming Burst.

label.zh: 仅牵缠退场且束裂未结束时
label.en: Only bound exit with Binding Sunder still running

title.zh: 喷发连拳，终结一击再交棒
title.en: Finish the Morale-Burst punches before switching

input.zh: 80士气以上进入第五段，连点或长按打出刺拳，完成终结一击。
input.en: Enter Basic 5 with at least 80 Morale; tap or hold for the punches and finish the final strike.

trigger.zh: 士气喷发实际启动，目标可持续命中。
trigger.en: Morale Burst actually starts and the target remains hittable.

complete.zh: 确认喷发中的轻拳/刺拳命中、昂扬实际叠层，终结一击命中施加溃败。
complete.en: Verify Burst punches and actual Elation stacks, then land the finisher for Collapse.

reason.zh: 冰火减抗、昂扬、延长失衡各有命中条件；提前切走不能当全部完成。
reason.en: Resistance reduction, Elation and extended Stun have hit requirements; an early switch cannot complete them automatically.

fallback.zh: 中断后按剩余士气重新检查；没打中终结一击就不计溃败。
fallback.en: After interruption, recheck remaining Morale; no finisher hit means no Collapse credit.

prep.zh: 已有3点且有输出机会时可先主动连携；敌人马上失衡时保留需要的资源进爆发。
prep.en: At three points, a suitable opportunity can use a personal Chain; near Stun preserve the resources needed for burst.

prep.zh: 切莱特前检查是否仍牵缠；束裂已引爆退出时，不显示额外自动束裂收益。
prep.en: Before switching to Lighter, check the tether. An already detonated/ended Seal does not grant another exit Sunder.

objective.zh: 区分敌人连携、3点主动连携和嘉音替换连携。
objective.en: Distinguish enemy Chains, three-point personal Chains and Astra-converted Chains.

title.zh: 敌人连携提示允许时，伊芙琳入场
title.en: Enter with Evelyn when enemy Chain prompts permit

input.zh: 在实际连携选项中选择伊芙琳。
input.en: Select Evelyn from the actual Chain options.

trigger.zh: 敌人已失衡且该选项出现；嘉音唱歌且有25能量时检查入场加攻。
trigger.en: Target Stunned and this option present; with Astra singing and 25 energy, check the entry ATK buff.

complete.zh: 连携命中完成后再用主动资源；不把打失衡和主动连携混为同一个次数。
complete.en: Finish the Chain hit before spending personal resources; enemy-triggered and personal Chains are separate.

reason.zh: 保留完整伤害结算，再操作同一角色的下一招。
reason.en: Let damage resolve before attempting another action by the same agent.

fallback.zh: 没有敌人连携提示可跳过，已有3点仍能走自己的主动连携。
fallback.en: Skip absent enemy prompts; three personal points still allow the personal Chain.

title.en: At three Tether Points, use the personal Chain

input.zh: 真实拥有3点时长按普攻或特殊技。
input.en: Hold Basic or Special with three actual Tether Points.

trigger.zh: 点数已达到3，目标可命中，所需增益实际覆盖。
trigger.en: Three points, a hittable target and the intended buffs actually active.

complete.zh: 完整确认连携伤害结算；未觉醒消耗全部，已觉醒保留1点。
complete.en: Confirm the Chain’s damage resolves; all points are consumed before awakening, one remains afterward.

reason.zh: 这是角色资源触发的主动连携，不需要伪造敌人连携次数。
reason.en: This personal-resource Chain does not require inventing enemy Chain opportunities.

fallback.zh: 不足3点回绞勒积蓄；关键伤害未落地前不要再次调用同角色动作。
fallback.en: Below three, build through Garrote; do not start another same-agent action before the key damage resolves.

title.zh: 嘉音终结技，准备替换连携

input.zh: 嘉音自己的终结技已就绪时发动。

trigger.zh: 终结技可用；希望把下次实际支援机会交给伊芙琳。
trigger.en: Ultimate ready, with the intention of giving Evelyn the next actual assist opportunity.

complete.zh: 终结技发动后取得下两次快支转连携；只在实际伊芙琳提示出现时接下一步。
complete.en: After use, the next two Quick Assists convert to Chains. Continue only when the real Evelyn prompt appears.

reason.zh: 次数全队共享使用，不能一看开大就自动给伊芙琳记两次连携。
reason.en: The uses can be consumed by the squad; activating Ultimate does not automatically give Evelyn both Chains.

fallback.zh: 提示属于莱特或资源不足时先按实际状态调整；没有伊芙琳提示就不执行下一步。
fallback.en: If the prompt belongs to Lighter or resources are missing, adjust to the actual state; skip the next step without Evelyn’s prompt.

signal.zh: 只接实际显示给伊芙琳的替换连携提示。
signal.en: Take only the actual converted Chain prompt for Evelyn.

title.zh: 按真实提示，伊芙琳连携接手
title.en: Enter through Evelyn’s actual converted Chain

input.zh: 在嘉音终结技后的伊芙琳支援转连携提示中按对应键。
input.en: Use the actual Evelyn assist-to-Chain prompt after Astra’s Ultimate.

trigger.zh: 嘉音替换次数尚在，提示对象确实是伊芙琳。
trigger.en: Astra has a conversion use left and the prompt actually targets Evelyn.

complete.zh: 让连携命中并完成结算；若另有次数，仍重新检查下一次实际提示。
complete.en: Let the Chain hit and finish resolving; a remaining use still needs another real prompt.

reason.zh: 该连携不消耗伊芙琳3点主动连携资源；不承诺一个失衡窗固定五次或六次。
reason.en: This conversion does not spend Evelyn’s three personal points; no fixed five/six Chains per Stun are promised.

fallback.zh: 无提示或次数用完就停止此分支，回真实燎火/点数循环。
fallback.en: Without a prompt or remaining use, stop this branch and return to the actual Embers/points loop.

prep.zh: 若嘉音终结技未好，跳过最后两步；按实际燎火与点数继续，不空等。
prep.en: If Astra Ultimate is unavailable, skip the last two steps and continue with actual Embers/points rather than waiting.

prep.zh: 三种入口各自核对，不保证每个窗口都具备全部资源。
prep.en: Check all three entry types separately; not every window has every resource.

text.zh: 1影开局喧响加快首次终结技，但不是每轮重发，也不等于开场就已觉醒。
text.en: M1’s starting Decibels accelerate the first Ultimate but do not repeat each loop or pre-activate awakening.

text.zh: 2影返还的是触发那次绞勒实际消耗的燎火，存在冷却；仍检查3点门槛。
text.en: M2 refunds the Embers spent by the triggering Garrote, with a cooldown; the three-point gate still applies.

text.zh: 莱特1影延长溃败效果，仍需要喷发终结一击命中。
text.en: Lighter M1 improves Collapse, still requiring the Burst finisher to land.

text.zh: 伊芙琳专武在接战、连携或终结技发动时取得心弦，按实际层数和时长确认。
text.en: Evelyn’s signature gains Heartstring on combat entry, Chain or Ultimate use; check actual stacks and duration.

text.zh: 嘉音专武全队增伤要实际消耗至少25能量触发；不能只因开唱就算满两层。
text.en: Astra’s signature team damage buff needs an actual spend of at least 25 energy; singing alone does not grant two stacks.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.80士气后，莱特快支接第五段: 士气达到80后让莱特入场

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.敌人连携提示允许时，伊芙琳入场: 出现连携提示时选伊芙琳

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.80士气以上进入第五段，连点或长按打出刺拳，完成终结一击。: 士气至少80时接普攻第五段，继续连点或长按普攻打刺拳，等最后一击命中。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普攻积蓄，按实际攻击机会闪避反击；第五段命中可重新牵缠。: 点按普攻积蓄燎火；第五段命中可重新牵缠。敌人出手时可闪避，再按普攻反击。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.首次终结技已就绪时发动；已觉醒时对应后续终结技分支。: 伊芙琳的终结技就绪时按终结技。首次使用会觉醒；已觉醒则走对应的后续招式。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.嘉音自己的终结技已就绪时发动。: 嘉音的终结技就绪时按终结技，再留意队友的入场提示。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.在嘉音终结技后的伊芙琳支援转连携提示中按对应键。: 嘉音终结技命中后，看到伊芙琳那次支援已变成连携提示，再选伊芙琳入场。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1161: 先看士气；士气不足时按当前普攻连段推进，达到80并实际进入第五段才连打刺拳。
ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1321: 未牵缠先点特殊技并命中，点普攻积燎火；满50%才长按普攻消耗。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.131100005: 点按特殊技，等攻击命中并进入驻唱
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.131100012: 喧响到「极」且终结技就绪时点按终结技，等命中

116100001: 本步需要接到普攻第五段后连点或长按打刺拳；从快支直达第五段时不用从第一段重打。
Continue or hold Basic from hit 5 for the punches. If Quick Assist already linked to hit 5, do not restart from hit 1.
116100010: 快支后点按或长按普攻，可直接接第五段；本路线要打刺拳才接，不必先点五次。
After Quick Assist, tap or hold Basic for direct hit 5 when following the punches route. No five preliminary taps.
132100001: 本步点普攻积燎火；要用第五段重新牵缠，才需打到第五段命中。
Build Burning Embers with Basics. Only the rebind route requires Basic hit 5 to land.
132100003: 燎火达到50%后长按普攻；有余量才继续长按接下一式，不用固定段数的普攻起手。
Hold Basic at 50% Burning Embers. Hold for the next form only if resources permit; no numbered Basic opener.
132100011: 3点燎索时，长按普攻或特殊技，二选一。选特殊技就不用再按普攻。
At three Tether Points, hold either Basic or Special. No Basic is needed if using Special.

1161: 士气不足可用普攻积累；达到80且接上第五段才连点或长按普攻。
Use Basics if building Morale. Tap repeatedly or hold only when Morale reaches 80 and hit 5 is available.
